title: Triggered dark vacuum transition

baseline.label: ΛCDM
baseline.scope: Source adds NEDE to the six conventional parameters and compares with ΛCDM. The minimal test replaces the microscopic transition by a declared instantaneous fluid branch and uses a matched zero-NEDE control.
baseline.parameters_reason: No candidate input set is registered. Source illustrative or fitted values are not adopted as prospect parameters.

cosmology.gravity: GR Friedmann evolution and covariant metric/fluid matching; source Eqs.(7),(12)-(14).
cosmology.geometry: Homogeneous FLRW background with synchronous-gauge perturbations. Standard flat ΛCDM implementation is inferred from the six-parameter set; exact code configuration is uninspected.
components: Retained baryons, CDM, photons/radiation, the specified neutrino sector and conventional late Λ.
Added tunneling field psi and subdominant ultralight trigger phi.
modifications: False-vacuum energy converts into an effective constant-w fluid at a trigger-defined transition.
The source fit fixes the post-transition EOS branch; the minimal background test does not derive it from bubble collisions.
cosmology.background: Continuous density and H with a pressure-induced Hdot jump. Source normalizes NEDE relative to the true vacuum; the extra false-vacuum energy must not be confused with the retained late Λ.
cosmology.perturbations: Source closes the effective fluid with rest-frame sound speed squared equal to its EOS and matches fluctuations on a constant-trigger surface. The minimal piecewise test omits trigger evolution and perturbation matching.
observables: Minimal test: density/H matching, signed Hdot jump, continuity residuals, post-transition dilution and fixed-endpoint r_s.
Source: CMB/lensing, BAO/growth, SN, BBN and H0 likelihoods; GW consequences are proposed rather than computed here.

scope: Audit conservation and junction conventions in a piecewise background.
Lost scope: tunneling/percolation, bubble coarse-graining, trigger fluctuations, finite transition corrections and CMB/LSS/GW inference.
Background NEDE is not the full trigger-consistent model.
unknowns: Microscopic realization of the post-collision EOS and finite-duration corrections.
Residual trigger dust and hypersurface robustness.
Exact code curvature/closure, initial data, reference outputs, likelihood files and cross-covariance.

combination_compatibility.basis: Unchecked beyond the explicitly sourced branch; shared topic membership does not authorize mixing mechanisms.
